verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.

sources.scope: No known scalar polynomial example; excludes homogeneous, quadratic and cubic cases and several tangent cones, without ruling out all dimensions/degrees.
Exact nonlinear polynomial question distinct from polynomial growth.

registry_checks: No minimalgraph matchingalias Palomar/Hexagon/OpenAI/Colbrook metadata. Current primary arXiv/publisher/author searches plus Zenodo/HAL/GitHub; ProofAtlas/Epoch routing pages are open-problem descriptions, not resolution evidence.
scope_comparison: Existence of some n>=8 and exact real polynomial identity. Vector-valued holomorphic polynomial minimal graphs, anisotropic six-dimensional construction, and scalar nonpolynomial examples do not meet it. Restricted degree exclusions leave existential target.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement.
